country:UKR.headline: Falling by 5.7 days per decade
country:UKR.detail: Significant. If nothing were really changing, a pattern this strong would turn up by chance less than 1 time in 100. The total change since 1981 is larger than the usual year-to-year swing (2.2 times it), so the region is far outside its normal range.
